items.title: Show HN: Adaptive Recall, persistent memory for AI assistants over MCP
items.summary: Adaptive Recall is introduced as a new 'Show HN' project providing persistent memory capabilities for AI assistants, utilizing the Model Context Protocol (MCP).

items.title: AI's memory. On your machine, under your control
items.summary: A new project focuses on developing persistent AI memory that operates locally on user machines, ensuring user control.

items.title: Mnema: A local, encrypted memory layer for AI agents
items.summary: Mnema is a new project that provides a local, encrypted memory layer specifically designed for AI agents to store and recall information.

items.title: AI agents win at Slay the Spire 2 after researchers replace growing chat logs with structured memory
items.summary: Researchers improved AI agent performance in Slay the Spire 2 by replacing chat logs with five separate structured memory layers, managing context window size.

items.title: ContextOps, an ESLint-like static analyzer for LLM context
items.summary: ContextOps is presented as a static analyzer, similar to ESLint, specifically designed to analyze and manage the context windows of large language models.

items.title: browser-use/browser-use  ★104,325

items.title: rasbt/LLMs-from-scratch  ★98,932
items.summary: This project provides a step-by-step guide on how to implement a ChatGPT-like Large Language Model (LLM) using PyTorch from fundamental principles.
